title: Planning And Decision Making
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a vital tool for effective production planning."
Forecasting is a vital tool for effective production planning.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very important step in planning; a plan cannot be said to exist unless a decision is taken."
Making decision is a very important step in planning; a plan cannot be said to exist unless a decision is taken.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a device that displays graphically the various actions that a manager can take and how these actions will relate to the various future events that occur (Stoner, 1978)."
A decision tree is a device that displays graphically the various actions that a manager can take and how these actions will relate to the various future events that occur (Stoner, 1978).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used interchangeably with purpose by many writers and authors."
Mission is used interchangeably with purpose by many writers and authors.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of deciding what objectives to pursue and choosing strategies that will help the organisation reach those objectives."
Planning is the process of deciding what objectives to pursue and choosing strategies that will help the organisation reach those objectives.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are responsible for the development of as many alternatives that will help make their strategy feasible."
Managers are responsible for the development of as many alternatives that will help make their strategy feasible.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a plan of action designed to achieve a particular goal."
Strategy refers to a plan of action designed to achieve a particular goal.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a formal short written statement of the purpose of an organisation."
A mission statement is a formal short written statement of the purpose of an organisation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to evaluate results, but the causes of failure or success are not frequently investigated."
Budgets are used to evaluate results, but the causes of failure or success are not frequently investigated.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means of evaluation, this is because performance can more easily be measured against previously benchmarks. 7."
Budget serve as a means of evaluation, this is because performance can more easily be measured against previously benchmarks. 7.
fib: ______ is defined as the selection process leading to a particular action.
decision
A decision is defined as the selection process leading to a particular action.
______ are those that are made in response to relatively novel problems and opportunities in the organisation.
non-programmed decisions
The non-programmed decisions are those that are made in response to relatively novel problems and opportunities in the organisation.
______ is a decision making technique emphasising the equal contribution of a group member through the mechanism of voting (Delbecg, 1975).
Nominal grouping
Nominal grouping is a decision making technique emphasising the equal contribution of a group member through the mechanism of voting (Delbecg, 1975).
______ is a financial document used to project future income and expenses (Jean Murray, 2011).
budget
A budget is a financial document used to project future income and expenses (Jean Murray, 2011).

______ is a process of identifying goals and objectives, defining managerial responsibilities in terms of expected results and measuring performance and achievement against these goals and objectives.
MBO
MBO is a process of identifying goals and objectives, defining managerial responsibilities in terms of expected results and measuring performance and achievement against these goals and objectives.
______ is a crucial aspect of any plan.
process of controlling
The process of controlling is a crucial aspect of any plan.
______ are the most difficult; in such situations, a manager has no knowledge on which to even estimate the likelihood of various outcomes.
Decisions under conditions of uncertainty
Decisions under conditions of uncertainty are the most difficult; in such situations, a manager has no knowledge on which to even estimate the likelihood of various outcomes.
______ are used to predict future problems and events, this is because it is mainly concerned with the future and as such involves many uncertainties.
Forecasting techniques
Forecasting techniques are used to predict future problems and events, this is because it is mainly concerned with the future and as such involves many uncertainties.
______ is a general guideline for decision making.
policy
A policy is a general guideline for decision making.
